chapters.reason: The paper explicitly proposes a method to convert existing pre-trained Transformers into RNNs (linearized models) through a process of 'uptraining' or distillation.
The core objective is to transform Transformers into linear-state recurrent models to achieve subquadratic inference costs.
The approach leverages the existing pre-trained weights of Transformers to develop recurrent capabilities, focusing on the transition from standard architectures to recurrent ones.
